title: Basic training at Fort McClellan
summary: He did basic training at Fort McClellan and disliked the small town.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: I gather that when you were in the Army, you did your basic training at Fort McClellan in Arkansas, where Lester Young not so long before had had his horrible experience.
Oh, yeah. Well, I didn’t know about Lester Young at that time. But I spent basic training at Fort McClellan. It was a small town, and I didn’t like it there.
